name: 세모지스타일
description: 세상의모든지식 채널 메인 아트스타일. 심플하고 귀여운 2D 플랫 디자인
scene_style_description: The attached image is a 2D flat design with no border in style.

style.art_style: Borderless 2D flat design with simple, rounded characters

linework.outline: Simple, rounded, and clean lines without intricate details
linework.variation: Smooth, minimalist outlines with no visible strokes or rough edges

style.shapes: Chubby and friendly proportions. Round faces, stout bodies, and generally cute or approachable proportions. Heads are slightly oversized in relation to the body
style.color_palette: Flat, bold colors. Solid blocks of color with minimal gradients or shading. Colors are bright but slightly muted, giving a retro feel
style.shading: Limited texture. Clothing and hair have a smooth, almost plastic-like appearance, with no visible fabric textures or hair strands
style.character_design: Minimalist facial features. Eyes are simple dots or small ovals, with minimal to no indication of a nose or mouth beyond simple lines. Eyebrows are thick and expressive. Stylized hands with few visible fingers, feet depicted as simple ovals or block shapes

critical_requirements: FLAT 2D illustration style, absolutely NO 3D rendering or shading
NO outlines, NO borders, NO black strokes around shapes
Simple flat color fills only, NO gradients, NO highlights, NO shadows
Soft, muted pastel color palette with flat fills
